name: End-to-end journey: home to first question

planSteps.description: Click the 'Take a test' call-to-action button to reach the Start page
Verify the Start page hero heading reads 'Pick an assessment to start'.
Click the 'Start' button on the Solstice assessment card
Verify a modal opens showing the title 'Start Solstice' and the text '36 questions'.
Click the 'Begin' button inside the modal
Verify the take page shows a progress indicator containing '36' and an 'Exit' link.
